name: Tsuzura Tomoe
source:
Sayuri's classmate. She is graceful and doll-like.

"Sakura-san is... a kind person, isn't he?"

"No... forgive me! Please forgive me!!"


[Translated from [url=https://ci-en.net/creator/9677/article?mode=detail&page=3]official website[/url]]
